access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; used as an alternative to VASP.
Public library of pseudopotentials; suitable PAW or ultrasoft pseudopotentials for Ti (with semicore) and O for PBE functional with +U capability.
Crystallographic data for anatase (I41/amd, a=3.7832 Å, c=9.5066 Å); the supercells can be built from these lattice parameters.
